notes.title: Fix Bug
notes.content:
-Fixed the problem that the possession time in the tutorial stage is too short, resulting in the inability to pass the level.
-Fixed the problem that in the store interface, after viewing the card, pressing ESC to close all windows.
-Fixed the release direction of the tank charging skill to follow the turret
-Reduce the sound effects of possession/detachment
-Fixed the problem that the bomb does not explode in the snow scene, RPG charging.
-Fixed the problem that the bullet does not track when fighting the boss
-Fixed the problem that the grenade does not explode when hitting the boss
-Fixed the problem that some languages ​​cannot open the game
